items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 3:36 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: National Day of Remembrance of the Quebec City Mosque Attack
notes: The Mayor acknowledged the National Day of Remembrance of the Quebec City Mosque attack and led Member of Council through a moment of silence.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Item 8.1 - City Owned Land Review (Land Acquisition and Disposition Section 239 (2) (c)) - Councillor B. Ioannidis
notes: Councillor B. Ioannidis declared a pecuniary interest on part of item 8.1 - City Owned Land Review (Land Acquisition and Disposition Section 239 (2) (c)) on the in-camera meeting agenda this date, due to his place of employment and did not participate in any voting or discussion on this matter.

items.title: Item 8.1 - City Owned Land Review (Land Acquisition and Disposition Section 239 (2) (c)) - Councillor P. Singh
notes: Councillor P. Singh declared a pecuniary interest on part of item 8.1 - City Owned Land Review (Land Acquisition and Disposition Section 239 (2) (c)) on the in-camera meeting agenda this date, as a member of his family owns property within the vicinity of the subject matter and did not participate in any voting or discussion on this matter.

items.title: Planning and Strategic Initiatives Committee Report - January 22, 2024
Official Plan Amendment Application OPA23/019/H/TS, Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA23/034/H/TS, 485 Huron Road, Activa Holdings Inc., DSD-2024-028
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
In-camera Meeting Authorization
By-laws
Three Readings
Being a by-law to adopt Amendment No. 42 to the Official Plan - 485 Huron Road.
Being a by-law to amend By-law 2019-051, as amended, known as the Zoning By-law for the City of Kitchener – Activa Holdings Inc. – 485 Huron Road.
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for January 29, 2024.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 3:47 p.m.

motions.item_title: Official Plan Amendment Application OPA23/019/H/TS, Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA23/034/H/TS, 485 Huron Road, Activa Holdings Inc., DSD-2024-028
motions.text: "That Official Plan Amendment Application OPA23/019/H/TS for Activa Holdings Inc., for the property municipally addressed as 485 Huron Road, requesting the amendment of Special Policy Area 41 for the lands specified and illustrated as the “Area or Amendment” on Schedule ‘A’, be adopted, in the form shown in the Official Plan Amendment attached to Development Services Department Report DSD-2024-028 as Appendix ‘A’, and accordingly forwarded to the Region of Waterloo for approval; and further, That Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA23/034/H/TS for Activa Holdings Inc. be approved in the form shown in the ‘Proposed By-law’ attached to Development Services Department Report DSD-2024-028 as Appendix ‘B’."
